_about: Crop table for shelf-life and respiration. Edit freely. JSON has no comments, so every crop has a 'source' field. SL_ref_days is the storage life when kept at T_ref_C. Q10 = how many times faster quality is lost for every 10 C warmer. Q10 values are typical literature ranges (2-4 for fresh produce) and are APPROXIMATE - treat shelf-life output as an estimate, not a guarantee.

tomato.label: Tomato (firm-ripe)
tomato.source: USDA Agriculture Handbook 66 (2016), Tomato: firm-ripe 10-12 C for safe storage (8-10 C only for a few days), 1-3 weeks, chilling-sensitive below ~10 C. Respiration ~25-45 mW/kg at 10 C (ASHRAE Refrigeration Handbook, Commodity Storage Requirements). Q10 2.5 typical for produce (assumed).

leafy_greens.label: Leafy greens (spinach / lettuce)
leafy_greens.source: USDA Agriculture Handbook 66 (2016), Spinach: 0 C, 95-100 % RH, 10-14 days. Respiration ~20-30 mW/kg at 0 C (ASHRAE). Q10 ~3 for leafy vegetables (assumed, literature range 2-4).

grapes.label: Grapes (table)
grapes.source: USDA Agriculture Handbook 66 (2016), Grape: -1 to 0 C, 1-6 months depending on cultivar; 6 weeks used (conservative, no SO2 pads). Respiration ~3-7 mW/kg at 0 C (ASHRAE). Q10 3 assumed.

pomegranate.label: Pomegranate
pomegranate.source: USDA Agriculture Handbook 66 (2016), Pomegranate: 5 C, 90-95 % RH, 2-3 months; chilling injury below 5 C. Respiration ~5-10 mW/kg at 5 C (approximate). Q10 2.5 assumed.

mango.label: Mango
mango.source: USDA Agriculture Handbook 66 (2016), Mango: 13 C, 2-3 weeks; chilling injury below 10-13 C depending on cultivar (12 C used). Respiration ~50-90 mW/kg at 13 C (ASHRAE). Q10 2.5 assumed. NOTE: our 2-8 C room is too cold for mango - the site will warn.

milk.label: Milk (pasteurised, packed)
milk.source: FSSAI / typical dairy practice: pasteurised milk at or below 4 C, about 7-14 days; 10 days used. Spoilage Q10 ~3 for psychrotrophic bacteria (assumed). Not a living product, so no respiration heat.

vaccines.label: Vaccines (VVM30 class, illustrative)
vaccines.source: WHO: store at +2 to +8 C, do not freeze. VVM30 category = end point after 30 days at 37 C or 4 years at 5 C (WHO PQS E006/IN05). Q10 derived from those two points: (1460/30)^(10/32) = 3.37. Illustrative only - real vaccines follow their own VVM.
